optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Digital Product Manager, Developer Tools Platform

professionalSummary.text: Sets the direction for the deployment service on the internal developer tools platform and settles backlog order with platform engineering and a rotating group of engineering teams that depend on the service.
professionalSummary.witness: Set the direction for the deployment service on the internal developer tools platform; every sprint I settled the backlog order with platform engineering and a rotating group of the engineering teams that depend on the service.

professionalSummary.text: Chairs deployment-service release reviews and keeps the decision log, including deferred items and reasons.
professionalSummary.witness: Chaired the review for all eight deployment-service releases that year and kept the decision log, including what was deferred and why.

professionalSummary.text: Raises the share of deployments completed without manual intervention, reported against the platform's documented monthly baseline.
professionalSummary.witness: The share of deployments completed without manual intervention rose from 62 percent to 84 percent in the three months after the automated rollback release, per the platform's monthly deployment report against its documented baseline of 62 percent.

professionalSummary.text: Lines up releases with platform engineering and consuming teams, with dates and rollout order decisions recorded by the platform engineering manager.
professionalSummary.witness: Lined each release up with the platform engineering manager and the consuming teams; dates and the order in which teams were moved over were the platform engineering manager's decisions.

professionalSummary.text: Keeps release notes current, including limitations of automated rollback and on-call hand-over notes.
professionalSummary.witness: Kept the release notes current; they record, for instance, that automated rollback does not yet cover database migrations, and carry the hand-over notes the platform on-call rota relies on.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample: a year of the monthly deployment report showing share of deployments without manual intervention, baseline, and rollback release marking, with report identifiers for tracing.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: a year of the monthly deployment report (share of deployments without manual intervention, the baseline and the rollback release marked) together with the decision log for the rollback release; report identifiers are included for tracing.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role in setting direction, chairing reviews, raising deployment automation metrics, lining up releases, and maintaining release notes, but do not establish the candidate's ownership of the deployment service roadmap, the specific metrics baseline definition, or the exact time window for the metric change.

decisionBoundary.statement: Qualified human review is required before any employment decision.

role.roleTitle: Digital Product Manager, Developer Tools Platform

evidence.text: Set the direction for the deployment service on the internal developer tools platform; every sprint I settled the backlog order with platform engineering and a rotating group of the engineering teams that depend on the service.
evidence.notes: Directly addresses setting direction and backlog order with platform engineering and dependent teams.

evidence.text: Chaired the review for all eight deployment-service releases that year and kept the decision log, including what was deferred and why.
evidence.notes: Directly addresses chairing reviews and maintaining decision log.

evidence.text: The share of deployments completed without manual intervention rose from 62 percent to 84 percent in the three months after the automated rollback release, per the platform's monthly deployment report against its documented baseline of 62 percent.
evidence.notes: Directly addresses metric change against documented baseline.

evidence.text: Reference call with the former platform engineering manager: the intervention numbers are from the monthly deployment report, automated rollback was the candidate's roadmap item, and the dates match.
evidence.notes: Confirms metric source and candidate's role in roadmap item.

evidence.text: Lined each release up with the platform engineering manager and the consuming teams; dates and the order in which teams were moved over were the platform engineering manager's decisions.
evidence.notes: Directly addresses lining up releases with platform engineering and consuming teams, with decisions recorded by manager.

evidence.text: Kept the release notes current; they record, for instance, that automated rollback does not yet cover database migrations, and carry the hand-over notes the platform on-call rota relies on.
evidence.notes: Directly addresses keeping release notes current with limitations and hand-over notes.

supportedClaims.witness: Lined each release up with the platform engineering manager and the consuming teams; dates and the order in which teams were moved over were the platform engineering manager's decisions.
